name: Bay Area Speedcubin' 27 - Mill Valley 2020

organisers.name: Evan Akira Mann (マンエヴァン朗)

information: Bay Area Speedcubin' is proud to host our first ever competition in beautiful Marin County! The event is only seven miles north of the Golden Gate Bridge, so come join us! **If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.**
